note: FALLBACK SNAPSHOT ONLY. The Notion page is the source of truth. Fetch it live each run (see SKILL.md). Use this file only when the Notion connector is unavailable, and warn the user that rates may be stale. US & Canada are USD; Netherlands is EUR + 21% VAT and uses a different basis (per-carton, tiered admin) — see the `netherlands` block and references/netherlands.md.

labor_tax.note: 5% NJ admin labor tax, applied only during active_periods (each interval is [from, until); from=null means open start, until=null means open-ended; an interval may carry its own 'rate' to override). History: active through the week of April 13 (last taxed invoice billed 2026-04-20 at $1,124.55); dropped from the week of April 20 (invoiced 2026-04-27 at $1,071.00). If the tax returns, append another interval (e.g. {"from": "2026-09-01", "until": null}).

netherlands.basis_note: Outbound priced per CARTON (not per order). 2025 cost levels, subject to annual Panteia/NEA indexation. €6,222/month minimum for warehouse activities.

small_parcel_dtc.note: €2.89/carton includes shipping-label application (no separate label fee).

outbound_b2b.note: 'Outbound Order Fulfillment B2B' €1.89/carton includes pallet config, wrapping, pack-list (covers stretchwrap). NL does not separate VC small-parcel vs LTL.

transport.transport_outbound: variable (weight/volume/lane tariff) — not rate-card checkable without the Benelux freight tariff
transport.note: Outbound EU delivery invoices: per-order Transport Outbound + Fuel Surcharge (% of transport) + Amazon Delivery (flat €100). Subject to 21% VAT.

footnotes.new_jersey_admin: New Jersey weekly $1,071 base = $1,124.55 with 5% labor tax
